issues.what: Block 1 shot 3 (00:05.0-00:07.9, still with FUEL: EMPTY): impossible physics and wrong object. The 'wing cutaway' is a top-down view of a small blue propeller-plane body with an open box in it. The single orange fuel drop hangs and falls from the outer lower edge of the tank frame, through the solid skin and out into open sky, so fuel leaves the 'empty' tank through its wall. Not an airliner wing.

fix.repair: Replace the AI still with a text-free three.js cutaway: translucent airliner wing outline, hollow tank inside it, one drop falling INSIDE the tank to the floor, level stays empty, slow push-in. Keep the assembler overlay FUEL: EMPTY.
